model_status: executed engineering screen; not MCU firmware, complete PMSM/SVPWM, LM5008A vendor macromodel, thermal model, or bench qualification

current_loop.motor_parameter_sensitivity: screened R=10/25/50/100/200mΩ, L=20/40/80/150/220/300µH, Vbus=22.5/32.4/37.8V; all are sensitivity points, not measured motor bounds
current_loop.pwm_ripple_envelope: worst-case two-level duty ripple ΔIpp≤Vbus/(4*fPWM*L); add half the bound to fundamental peak, assuming centered synchronous sample; not a switching simulation
current_loop.110a_l_means_effective_inductance_at_tes: measured phase inductance after saturation/temperature/rotor-angle effects; motor not yet received
current_loop.synchronous_sampling: one sample per PWM period, abstract centered sample; 12-bit ADC quantization included
current_loop.local_control_policy: screened candidate: command cap ±100A with 5000A/s reference slew at L=20µH; this run applies the selected command directly and checks peak current against 120A, it does not implement a hardware fast clamp. CAN timeout test ramps reference to zero after 100ms
current_loop.command_tracking_boundary: peak-envelope PASS only means modeled peak is below 120A; it does not prove the command was tracked. With fixed 12.83V back-EMF and 22.5V bus, positive drive can be voltage saturated; see per-case voltage_saturation_sample_fraction and iq_tail_mean_a
current_loop.important_boundary: average dq plant, one update-period delay; no switching/dead-time/Hall angle error/CSA offset. PI gains remain based on nominal 17mΩ/20µH; R/L are unknown until motor arrival. PWM envelope is conservative analytic bound, to verify on scope

bus_energy_cases.power_model: Pterminal=1.5*(12.83V*iq+R*iq^2); only negative terminal power enters bus ledger, excluding transient L energy and speed change
bus_energy_cases.boundary: fixed speed/back-EMF motor model, one-way source (cannot absorb) except stated finite sink, no mechanical deceleration or dump thermal model

buck_5v.architecture: retain DRV8353R integrated LM5008A buck, pending startup/recovery bench confirmation
buck_5v.startup_peak_current_upper_bound_method: Ilimit,max + VIN,max/Lmin * response_delay_max; conservative because it ignores VOUT, diode and winding drops during the delay
buck_5v.inductor_saturation_current_definition: Sumida defines this point where inductance falls 25% from initial value; the 1.45A table value is not used as a thermal-rise rating or relabeled as an Isat minimum

current_sense_adc_filter_cases.boundary: STM32G431 TT operating limit is VDD+0.3V (0.3V at VDD=0); 4.0V is absolute maximum only. ST Table 15 states no positive-injection path below the TT maximum input rating. Do not infer powered-off function, rail/reset behavior, or clamp current from these ratings; verify board power sequencing physically. This does not model injection current.

buck_5v.excluded_startup_load: WeAct 3.3V LDO output 10uF and its nonlinear start/load response; its 5V-side current was not quantified
buck_5v.capacitor_derating: 0.5 scale is a sensitivity only; exact effective capacitance vs bias/tolerance must be confirmed from TDK data and WeAct board BOM
buck_5v.usb_boundary: WeAct VBUS→VCC BAT54 path and external 5V reverse path are not electrically proved; prohibit powered USB insertion with coreboard installed until backfeed test
